_purpose: Real, source-traceable prospect list for weylandai.com (SubX/TakeoffX/PropX/SightX) — general contractors and subcontractors who ACTUALLY submitted bids on real public-agency construction projects, extracted by hand from real bid-tabulation PDFs downloaded by tools/bid-tabulation-crawler.mjs. NOT contacted. NOT outreach. Compilation only, per task constraints.
_methodology: Each source PDF was downloaded with a real GET (see tools/corpus/bid-tabulations/manifest.json for sha256/fetch timestamps) and its text extracted with pdftotext. Every row below was read directly off that extracted text by a human/agent, not produced by automated table-parsing — several of these bid-tab layouts are scanned/OCR'd or inconsistently formatted enough that generic regex extraction risks mis-attributing a name or dollar figure to the wrong row. 'role' is 'bidder-of-record' unless the source document itself states an award; where a company appears to be the lowest responsive bid, that is noted but NOT asserted as a confirmed award unless the document says so explicitly.

limitations: This is a small, hand-verified list (12 entries across 4 real bid-tabulation documents), not a scaled prospect pipeline. Scaling would require either a much larger seed list of known bid-tab URLs or solving the harder problem of reliably parsing heterogeneous bid-tab table layouts without fabricating structure that isn't really there.

Only 2 of the 12 entries (Mar-Paul Company Inc., Multiscape) are on a project with direct Division 08 (door/hardware) line items — the rest are general-construction/roofing/painting/landscape bidders on public K-12 work, which is still weylandai's target buyer profile (GCs and subs who respond to formal public bid packages) but not door-schedule-specific.

Most public agency bid postings do NOT publish bid tabulations at a stable, discoverable URL — of 6 search targets investigated (Rockford IL, Christina SD DE, Berryessa CA — the original door-schedule seeds — plus Winnacunnet NH and SPPS MN), only the 4 seeds in this crawler yielded a real, fetchable bid-tab PDF with named bidders. The Rockford/Christina/Berryessa results (searched again this session) still could not be located, consistent with the 2026-09-03 finding.

'Apparent low bidder' labels are informed guesses based on the lowest bid amount on a tabulation sheet, not a confirmed contract award — no seed document explicitly states 'AWARDED TO: ...'. Treat those labels as bidding activity, not proof of a signed contract.

No contact information (phone, email, named individual) was collected for any company — per task constraints, this is a compilation of company name + project + source, not an outreach-ready contact list.
